Description:

[font=Arial][size=2]I love answering questions, truly! So please ask away in the comments if you've got any issues or you just don't know how to shave properly and need a few hints...
Bob is here to help clear up that Fog!
[/size][/font]
[b][u][color=#f1c232][size=5]Maybe support the Patreon?[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[url=http://www.patreon.com/NoFogBob]https://www.patreon.com/NoFogBob[/url]﻿



[color=#6d9eeb][size=6][u][b][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776454-869883807.png[/img][/b][/u][/size][/color][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial][size=2]Do you also have trouble finding the panning spots? Look no further! This mod improves animation to make the panning spots more visible.

Adds pans above the panning spots to make them more visible. [color=#ff0000]Appearance configurable! Check the config.json to remove the sparkling gold from the pan! <----------[/color]

I would recommend getting [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4161]Better Panning[/url] along with this mod to maximize your panning experience...

Using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], a portion of "Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb" is replaced with my edited version.
[/size][/font][size=2][font=Arial]
Toggle extra glittering animation on/off in the config options as well as choosing from a variety of colors of rings to be added (or none)! Recommended to use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. After downloading click mod options at the bottom of the in-game options menu and then select this mod from the list. You can change these options mid-game and see the results live!

[/font][/size][i]
[/i]
[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u][font=Arial][size=2]
[color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]3)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[b][color=#f1c232]4)[/color][/b] Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Visible Panning Spots"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][font=Arial][size=2]
[/size][/font][/font]



[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776467-497634449.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u]
[font=Arial][size=2]Compatible with all versions of Stardew Valley.

[size=2]Compatible with Windows and macOS (I have not tested it on Linux but I don't see why it wouldn't work there too)[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Single-player and Multiplayer.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
-No mod [b]conflicts[/b] that I know of yet.
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=2][b]
-Issues [/b]may arise if you have any other mods installed that LOAD the same files. [/size][/font]
